description: Defines a PHP class 'Column' within the OrangeHRM reporting system. The class manages report column properties such as name, property identifier, pinning status, size, and cell properties, providing methods to set and retrieve these attributes with validation and serialization support.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a report column with customizable properties such as name, position pinning, size, and cell styling. Facilitates configuration and serialization of column attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Column with a specified property identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of the column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the column.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Retrieves the property identifier associated with the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier for the column.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Retrieves the pinning status (start/end) of the column.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pinning status of the column, validating accepted values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the size (width) of the column.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size (width) of the column.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Adds or merges additional cell style properties into existing ones.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the column properties into an associative array.
